properties.description:
2026/06/11 - 2026/06/12 | (2026/06/08) | The Austin FC Soccer Celebration is a free family-friendly public watch party commemorating the opening (2) days of the 2026 FIFA Mens World Cup taking place June 11 & 12 2026. The event will transform the east lawn of Auditorium Shores into a vibrant soccer fan destination with an anticipated capacity of approximately 5000 attendees. The celebration will feature live broadcasts of the matches on a large LED screen with audio support to create a communal viewing experience. Local DJ performances will activate the space and maintain momentum between matches.

In addition to match viewing the celebration will feature interactive fan engagement activations permitted food and beverage vendors official merchandise booths and thoughtfully designed gathering spaces to enhance the fan experience. The event layout will incorporate clearly defined ingress and egress points to support smooth crowd flow accessibility and efficient site management.

Public safety planning and overall event operations will be led by the C3 Presents team which has extensive experience coordinating with City of Austin agencies including PARD APD AFD ATCEMS and the Special Events Office. Comprehensive risk assessment professional security and crowd management staffing and dedicated operational oversight will be implemented to ensure a safe structured and professionally managed environment for all attendees.

properties.description:
Install one (1) EG4 FlexBOSS 21 Hybrid Inverter (240 V 16 kW AC output) and three (3) EG4 PowerPro All-Weather Lithium Batteries (51.2 VDC 280 Ah each;  14.3 kWh per unit 42.9 kWh total) at the existing residence.  Equipment will be wall-mounted on the northeast exterior garage wall adjacent to existing PV inverters and service equipment.  The system will integrate with two existing SolarEdge inverters (SE-10000H & SE-7600H) serving a 17.6 kWdc / 17.6 kWac rooftop PV array.

The new hybrid inverter and battery system will be interconnected through an EG4 GridBoss micro-grid interconnection device providing backup load capability and grid-interactive operation.  AC output from the FlexBOSS 21 will connect to the GridBoss and then to the existing 200 A main service panel (240 V 1-phase 3-wire underground service).  New conductors will be copper THWN-2 in EMT conduit sized per NEC 690.8 240 and 310.15 for a maximum 66.7 A inverter output.  OCPDs and disconnects will be provided per NEC 705.12 and 706.15.  A visible lockable labeled AC disconnect will be installed within 5 feet of the utility meter (Austin Energy #7163517).

All components will be UL listed and installed per manufacturers specifications 2023 NEC 2021 IRC/IBC/IFC and City of Austin Electrical Code.  System includes rapid-shutdown functionality proper signage and labeling per NEC 690 and 705.  No structural modifications are required.  Work includes conduit routing grounding electrode bonding labeling commissioning and verification of interconnection with Austin Energy prior to energization.

properties.description: At10615 Beckwood Dr Austin TX 78726 we plan to install a new code-compliant in-ground irrigation system designed and supervised by a TCEQ-licensed irrigator (License LI0030033). The system will connect to the City water supply with a tested DCV backflow preventer and a master valve and will be divided into properly sized zones for turf shrub beds and individual trees using a mix of high-efficiency MP rotors and drip emitters. PVC main and lateral lines will be buried to required depth wired through conduit. A WiFi compatible controller with rain sensor will automatically adjust watering schedules to meet Austin Water conservation standards avoiding overspray and runoff. Zone layout precipitation rates and run times are based on site hydraulics and plant needs and all components will be installed to meet or exceed City of Austin and TCEQ irrigation rules. Upon completion the system will be inspected the backflow device tested by a certified BPAT tester and the homeowner instructed in controller operation and seasonal maintenance.

properties.description:
This project involves the repair and rerouting of existing cast iron drain lines to modern PVC drain lines within the specified property. The purpose of the project is to address existing issues enhance drainage efficiency and ensure compliance with current plumbing standards and regulations.

Scope of Work:

Site Evaluation:
An initial assessment of the existing plumbing system will be conducted to determine the extent of repair and the optimal route for rerouting the drain lines.

Demolition and Removal:
Existing damaged or deteriorated cast iron drain lines will be carefully removed ensuring minimal disruption to the property.

New PVC Drain Line Installation:
New PVC drain lines will be installed routed and connected to the appropriate fixtures and main sewer lines following the approved plumbing design.

Fittings and Connections:
All necessary PVC fittings joints and connectors will be used to ensure a watertight and secure connection between pipes and fixtures.

Ventilation:
Proper ventilation pipes will be integrated into the system to maintain optimal airflow and prevent the buildup of sewer gases.

Sealing and Testing:
The entire plumbing system will be thoroughly tested for leaks and proper functionality. All joints and connections will be securely sealed.

Backfill and Restoration:
Trenches created for the new drain lines will be carefully backfilled and the site will be restored to its original condition ensuring minimal impact on landscaping and structures.
